from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class LegalDocument(BaseModel):
    """One legal document with its identified cause of action."""
    document_title: str | None = Field(description="The title or identifier of this legal document")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The cause of action (案由) as stated or determined in the document")
    case_category: str | None = Field(description="The broader legal category: '国家赔偿', '民事诉讼', '行政诉讼', '刑事诉讼', etc.")
    involves_execution_dispute: bool | None = Field(description="Whether the document discusses execution-related disputes")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="Short verbatim excerpt supporting the cause of action identification")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[LegalDocument]
